title: When the Sigil Breaks
author: Ansel Ashgrove
blurb: Ada Halloran, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
